title: Rendlesham Forest
dek: Over three nights in December 1980, airmen from two adjacent USAF bases in Suffolk reported lights in the forest, and a deputy base commander recorded his own account on a handheld tape.
also_known_as: Rendlesham, the Halt incident, Britain's Roswell

facts.witnesses: USAF personnel from Bentwaters and Woodbridge
facts.outcome: The Halt memo was released in 1983; the MoD closed its file without a determination.
